shared_elements: monolithic stone block bearing low-relief carving
curvilinear/looped relief lines on a rounded surface
suggestion of a massive human-derived form (head/torso block)
justification: Both surfaces show heavy monolithic blocks worked with shallow curvilinear relief — loops and rounded bands, with hints of circular/ring motifs — and in both the carving follows and wraps the bulging contour of the mass rather than sitting in a flat framed field, which is a real if unspecific correspondence. The decisive difference is that B unmistakably depicts a whole standing anthropomorphic figure with head, ears, arms and a decorated back including a prominent ring and belt-like bands, whereas A shows only isolated, eroded boulder faces with fragmentary curved motifs and no legible figure, relationships or ordered composition.
